scope: All 16 emitted originals of continuation batch 04 individually viewed at original detail; complete refers only to this review, not the nine-batch measurement or a workflow gate.

images.notes: Fresh Light entry has readable opening text and an assembled six-module pinned fixture. Face labels are visibly blurred.
Light opening rest keeps full question, ownership and explanatory note legible without object overlap or text clipping.
Middle visibly separates the fixture into two rows of three volumes; caption preserves the unresolved incident. Labels and spatial arrangement weakly explain the code/access/observation mapping.
Ending reunites the fixture with readable two-year projection versus 72-hour observed-run distinction and contact/compare links.
Pointer before shows Dark selected and Light available; dark background, pale prose and pale object indicators differ clearly from the Light destination.
Pointer after shows Light selected, pale background and dark prose. The same fixture and factual caption remain visible.
Keyboard before visibly focuses the unselected Light button while Dark remains selected.
Keyboard after retains visible Light focus and selected state while palette changes to Light; intended appearance response is visible.
Phone Light entry fits opening question, ownership, note and links. Volumes and pins are recognizable; object labels are effectively unreadable.
Phone opening rest remains legible and unclipped with the fixture above the caption; small face labels still provide little usable meaning.
Phone middle shows six separate modules and complete incident caveat. Visible separation is real, but the labels do not explain the named relationship at this size.
Phone ending rejoins the fixture and displays complete projection/run distinction, disclaimer and contact/compare links.
Phone pointer before shows Dark selected with readable pale text; Light control is visible at top right.
Phone pointer after shows Light selected and the intended pale-ground/dark-text appearance without losing opening content.
Phone keyboard before has a visible focus ring on Light while Dark stays selected.
Phone keyboard after shows focused and selected Light plus the intended palette change; all opening content and object remain visible.

controlFindings: Desktop and phone pointer trials start with Dark selected and reach Light, changing actual URL, look, palette and pressed states.
Desktop keyboard uses five real Tab presses and Enter; phone uses two Tab presses and Enter. Both before images visibly focus Light and both after images show selected Light.
limits: This is the existing fixture Light control, not another concept or a final look-selection gate.
Small blurred object labels and weak diagram-to-prose mapping remain; palette switching does not establish final spatial, material or visual-story quality.
No physical-phone, author acceptance, final-site, motion-quality or overall measurement pass is claimed.
provenance: Read saved reports/manifest and independently hashed/stat'ed all 16 PNGs, then opened each with view_image original. No browser, model, test, app runtime, cleanup or process-signalling command was issued for this review. A read-only jq attempt was unavailable; the manifest was read directly instead.
